question: We acquire hundreds of used electric assets daily, and we only have time to run a quick partial-cycle test on them. Take only the first 25% of the charge/discharge cycles from a historical test batch. Based purely on that limited data, predict their final Remaining Useful Life (RUL) and when they will hit their total capacity fade mark. Compare these partial-data predictions against the actual ground truth from the full test lifecycle. I need the MAE and RMSE to see if your platform can accurately value a used asset without running a full multi-day diagnostic.
